envelope.description: Add AnalyzeConfig.tiering.security + the tri-state parseSecurityModelPin parser

body.title: Add AnalyzeConfig.tiering.security + the tri-state parseSecurityModelPin parser
body.summary: Add a required, always-present tiering.security: SecurityModelPinResult tri-state field to AnalyzeConfig (corrected per LLD-0765b3a578e43eec-s1 revision 3: an optional field cannot distinguish absent from malformed, which resolveSecurityModelCandidate's fixed (cfg, registry) signature needs), populated by a NEW, dedicated parseSecurityModelPin(models: Record<string, unknown>) function in analyze.ts -- NOT a reuse of parseTieringOverride's existing silently-drops-to-undefined convention. Returns a tri-state result distinguishing {kind:'absent'} from {kind:'valid', runner, model, effort?} from {kind:'malformed', detail}.
acceptanceChecks: parseTieringOverride itself is untouched -- no shared logic or behavioral change to the existing tiers.* parsing path

tests.name: parseSecurityModelPin: no models.security key at all -> { kind: 'absent' }
parseSecurityModelPin: a complete, well-typed { runner, model } -> { kind: 'valid', ... }
parseSecurityModelPin: runner set with no model -> { kind: 'malformed', detail }
parseSecurityModelPin: runner is not a recognized FamilyId -> { kind: 'malformed', detail }
